# netcup Provider

Manage netcup DNS via the CCP (DomainWebservice) API or the netcup API for domains on CloudDNS, and reverse DNS, servers, users and VLANs via the SCP REST API. The APIs use independent credentials; configure whichever you need.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netcup = {
      source  = "hornc-greedy/netcup"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials may also be supplied via the environment variables
# NETCUP_CUSTOMER_NUMBER, NETCUP_API_KEY, NETCUP_API_PASSWORD,
# NETCUP_CLOUDDNS_API_KEY and NETCUP_SCP_REFRESH_TOKEN. Configure only the APIs
# you use.
provider "netcup" {
  customer_number = var.netcup_customer_number
  api_key         = var.netcup_api_key
  api_password    = var.netcup_api_password

  clouddns_api_key = var.netcup_clouddns_api_key

  scp_refresh_token = var.netcup_scp_refresh_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) netcup CCP API key. May also be set via `NETCUP_API_KEY`.
- `api_password` (String, Sensitive) netcup CCP API password. May also be set via `NETCUP_API_PASSWORD`.
- `clouddns_api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key of the netcup API for domains on CloudDNS, from the CCP under Master Data > API. May also be set via `NETCUP_CLOUDDNS_API_KEY`.
- `clouddns_base_url` (String) Host of the netcup API, by default `https://api.netcup.com`. May also be set via `NETCUP_CLOUDDNS_BASE_URL`.
- `customer_number` (String) netcup customer number (CCP API). May also be set via `NETCUP_CUSTOMER_NUMBER`.
- `scp_base_url` (String) SCP host, by default `https://www.servercontrolpanel.de`. May also be set via `NETCUP_SCP_BASE_URL`.
- `scp_refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) SCP REST API offline refresh token (obtained once via the OIDC device flow). Required only for SCP resources/data sources (reverse DNS, servers, users, VLANs and actions). May also be set via `NETCUP_SCP_REFRESH_TOKEN`.
